title: Application for Assistance with Cultural Facility Improvement Expenses
full_text:
Application for Assistance with Cultural Facility Improvement Expenses
Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities — Attached Form No. 1

Do not fill in shaded fields.
Receipt No.: ______ | Date received: ______ | Processing period: 60 days

Applicant
Institution name: ______
Business registration No. (unique identification No.): ______
Representative's name: ______ | Telephone: ______
Office address: ______

I hereby apply for assistance with cultural facility improvement expenses as stated above pursuant to Article 12(2) of the Act on the Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities, Article 6(2) of its Enforcement Decree, and Article 2(1) of its Enforcement Rules.

Year: ____ Month: ____ Day: ____
Applicant: ______ (signature or seal)

To: Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism; Special Metropolitan City Mayor; Metropolitan City Mayor; Special Self-Governing City Mayor; Do Governor; Special Self-Governing Province Governor; Si Mayor; Gun Head; or Gu Head

Attachments
1. Current status of the cultural facility to be improved
2. Improvement plan
3. Budget
Fee: None

Processing procedure
1. Prepare application — Applicant
2. Receipt
3. Examination of documents
4. Determination of eligibility for assistance
5. Payment of assistance
Processing authorities: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and local governments

210 mm × 297 mm [white paper (80 g/m²) or medium-grade paper (80 g/m²)]

metadata.self_review: AI full-text review against all three Korean form texts: all applicant fields, 60/30-day processing periods, recipients, exact Act/Decree/Rules references, attachments, official verification, no fee, five process stages, signatures/seals and paper specifications retained.
